brief: Stop pairing fonts wrong — 6 rules typographers use to make any combo work.

slots.description: A display variable font built for bold identities. Its confident geometry sets the tone for mastering typographic pairings.
A high-contrast transitional serif with dramatic thick-thin strokes. Pair it with a clean sans to let its elegance command attention.
A geometric sans-serif with nine distinct weights. Stack heavy against light within the same family to build instant hierarchy.
A neo-grotesque with retro-futuristic personality. Its distinctive letterforms shine when contrasted with a quieter partner.
Part of the DM superfamily alongside DM Serif. Share the same DNA across sans and serif for effortless cohesion.
A neo-grotesque built for screens with a tall x-height. Match it with fonts of similar proportions to keep reading calm.
A modern geometric sans with open, friendly shapes. It pairs so cleanly that you never need to invite a third typeface.

slots.body: Stop guessing and start pairing with confidence. Save these six rules and upgrade every layout.
